main.summary: Requests authoritative integrity evidence for a transfer prefix.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family of the requested session.

property.name: PrefixLength
property.summary: Exact prefix length for which integrity evidence is requested.

main.summary: Returns authoritative integrity evidence for a transfer prefix.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Canonical source session identifier, when the requested session follows another transfer.

property.name: SourceStateVersion
property.summary: Source state version associated with this evidence snapshot, or null for immutable published content.

property.name: Integrity
property.summary: Integrity summary for the requested prefix.

property.name: Segments
property.summary: Canonical source segments covering the requested prefix.

property.name: IsPublished
property.summary: True when the requested prefix is backed by immutable published content.
